result.summary: The 2019 page replaces the hacker-culture description (rewarding bold problem solving, 'this journey is 1% finished', mission to 'bring the world closer together') with a new framing: 'we're building a different kind of company that connects billions of people' and 'empower people around the world to build community'. This shifts the stated self-description and emphasis, while headcount, user counts, locations, bios and cookie text are updated or chrome.
